task: The input is the three-dimensional structure of a protein complex (represented in PDB/mmCIF format or Foldseek database format), and the output is the structural alignment result between the complexes, including the correspondence between chains, superimposition vectors, and the TM score used to quantify similarity. Its scientific goal is to achieve efficient search and similarity detection in large-scale protein complex structure databases (such as those containing millions of structures) through ultra-fast and sensitive alignment algorithms.

data.name: 7xg4.pdb
data.description: Provided structure from PDB entry 7XG4, a Pseudomonas aeruginosa type IV-A CRISPR-Cas complex. The supplied file contains nine protein chains (A-H and L). In the Foldseek-Multimer paper, 7XG4 is a structural hit for a predicted Sulfitobacter sp. JL08 complex. See ./data/README.md for the source of that separate predicted structure.

data.name: 6n40.pdb
data.description: Provided structure from PDB entry 6N40, the monomeric MmpL3 membrane protein from Mycobacterium smegmatis. The supplied file contains one protein chain (A); it is a different structure from the predicted Sulfitobacter sp. JL08 complex used in the paper. See https://www.rcsb.org/structure/6N40 and ./data/README.md for structure identities and source references.
